cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.
